items.text: Embedded Linux system development for BMC platforms
Implementation and maintenance of network management protocols
Secure communication services for platform management
System debugging, performance optimization, and field issue resolution
Embedded Linux & and strong experience in C++
Experience with system-level debugging (gdb, strace, logs)
Networking Protocols like SNMP, HTTP/HTTPS, Socket programming
Cybersecurity Fundamentals like TLS/SSL, Authentication mechanism
Linux build system (Yocto, Cross-compilation toolchains, shell scripting, git version control)
Secure boot / TPM / Hardware root of trust

description.text:
AI Data Center 是本事業群重要發展方向，因應 AI／GPU 算力快速成長，聚焦高速網路、電力、液冷散熱、800VDC、儲能及智慧能源管理等關鍵技術。加入我們，參與 AI Data Center 從電力、散熱、網路到能源管理的整合開發，與我們一起打造新世代 AI 基礎設施！
We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to develop and maintain BMC (Baseboard Management Controller) firmware and Linux-based embedded systems. The role focuses on system-level software development, network management protocols, and cybersecurity features for server/platform management.
You will work on:
• Embedded Linux system development for BMC platforms
• Implementation and maintenance of network management protocols
• Secure communication services for platform management
• System debugging, performance optimization, and field issue resolution
Required Skills
• Embedded Linux & and strong experience in C++
• Experience with system-level debugging (gdb, strace, logs)
• Networking Protocols like SNMP, HTTP/HTTPS, Socket programming
• Cybersecurity Fundamentals like TLS/SSL, Authentication mechanism
• Linux build system (Yocto, Cross-compilation toolchains, shell scripting, git version control)
Nice to Have
• BMC / Server Management
• REST-API and Redfish protocol
• Secure boot / TPM / Hardware root of trust
